accepted_behavior: dispatch_local_packet_with_arp_cache learns valid Ethernet/IPv4 ARP sender facts before existing local dispatch behavior
poll_local_network_device_with_arp_cache learns valid Ethernet/IPv4 ARP sender facts before existing local poll/transmit result behavior
ARP requests can still generate the same local ARP reply as cache-unaware dispatch
ARP replies learn the neighbor and produce no local transmit
malformed or unsupported ARP does not mutate the cache
non-ARP ICMP echo output remains compatible with dispatch_local_packet
no-frame receive outcomes leave cache state unchanged
transmit errors keep ARP facts learned before reply transmission failed
cache-unaware dispatch_local_packet and poll_local_network_device remain available and covered

findings.finding: Phase 12.3 now has accepted cache-aware local dispatch and poll entry points that learn ARP sender facts from validated inbound ARP request and reply frames
cache-unaware dispatch_local_packet and poll_local_network_device behavior remains source-compatible and covered by deterministic tests

core tests cover ARP request learning with reply transmission, ARP reply learning without transmit, malformed or unsupported ARP without cache mutation, unchanged ICMP echo output, no-frame cache behavior, and transmit-error cache behavior
no implementation correction was required during closeout because static/source/task evidence matched the accepted core claims

outbound neighbor resolution, packet queues, driver adapters, UDP/TCP, DHCP, DNS, routing, sockets, SSH, smoltcp integration, live packet I/O, and Pi 5 packet movement evidence remain future bounded work
no source, docs, dependencies, prior task evidence, or accepted APIs were removed by this closeout

outbound resolution implementation, packet queue readiness, live packet I/O, hardware-driver readiness, link readiness, ping/network reachability behavior, sockets, SSH, smoltcp adoption, and phase transition are not accepted by this closeout
